correctness.rationale: For every integer \(m,q\ge1\) with \(m+q\ge3\), descending-cardinality elementary pairings remove the \(2^m\) both-pole faces using b_1 (\(2^{m-1}\) pairs), then u- and v-sectors using the distinguished short arm (\(3^m 2^{q-1}\) pairs each), then each length-four arm interval factor (\(3^q\sum_i3^{i-1}5^{m-i}\) pairs), leaving exactly a join of m+q two-point discrete complexes. All competing one-vertex cofaces are already absent by ordering, so pairs are genuinely free; the count is exactly \(N(m,q)\). Invariant pole-deleted subcomplex A proves integral naturality and group action: each long factor reversal fixes component classes, each short factor swaps classes, and arm interchanges have the Koszul sign. Exact finite checker replays 2,829 pair collapses and 21 signed Lefschetz tests; universal proof does not depend on finite samples.

value.rationale: A uniform all-size simple-homotopy collapse and exact integral full-symmetry character for natural generalized theta graphs, including those with induced six-cycles excluded from Kim’s ternary-graph hypothesis, is a substantive structural computation. The presence of at least one length-four arm eliminates the extra integral circle of the all-short-arm multitheta family, and the explicit parameter count of elementary pairs gives a reproducible combinatorial certificate. The result does not claim an all-path-length or equivariant collapse theorem.
